thing.text:
TAKE OFF AND LOOP

Press SPACE on THE
AIRPLANE. Two behaviours
are bound to it and both
start at once:

  a 3D turtle -- which
    gives it move, yaw,
    pitch and roll
  the pilot -- which
    speaks them

"." lands it. Its pen is
down, so it draws its own
flight path as it goes.

A LOOP NEEDS NO COUNTING

The pilot's whole round is
three orders, always the
same three:

  move 10
  move 10
  pitch 30

Turn the same few degrees
every stride and the path
closes into a circle. Two
strides per turn makes the
arc wide, so it runs, lifts,
climbs, and comes over the
top. Twelve rounds is a
full 360.

TRY THIS

Open the pilot's panel and
change 30 to 45: a tighter
loop. Change it to 0 and it
flies straight until the
table runs out.

Post [roll | 30] to the bird
while it loops and the loop
tilts -- roll turns about
the line of travel, so it
changes the PLANE the loop
is drawn in.

"home" puts it back on the
table, level and facing the
far edge.
